What characterises the peptides binding to the HLAs? Save the plot under `results/`.

Same idea as in the exercises: unique 9-mer peptides for `A02:01`, then the same thing for `B07:02`.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggseqlogo)
library(here)

dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)

peptide_meta_data <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "03_dat_aug.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
#| fig-cap: "Unique 9-mer peptides on experiments typed as A02:01."

a02_peptides <- peptide_meta_data |>
  filter(Allele == "A02:01", k_peptide == 9) |>
  distinct(peptide) |>
  pull(peptide)

p_a02 <- ggseqlogo(a02_peptides, seq_type = "aa")

ggsave(
  here("results", "logo_peptide_A0201.png"),
  p_a02,
  width = 7,
  height = 3.2,
  dpi = 130
)

p_a02
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
#| fig-cap: "Unique 9-mer peptides on experiments typed as B07:02."

b07_peptides <- peptide_meta_data |>
  filter(Allele == "B07:02", k_peptide == 9) |>
  distinct(peptide) |>
  pull(peptide)

p_b07 <- ggseqlogo(b07_peptides, seq_type = "aa")

ggsave(
  here("results", "logo_peptide_B0702.png"),
  p_b07,
  width = 7,
  height = 3.2,
  dpi = 130
)

p_b07
```
